title: Sparkly bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- wheels -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='17' fill='#1a1a2e' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='3' fill='#00e5ff'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='17' fill='#1a1a2e' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='3' fill='#00e5ff'/>
    <!-- spokes -->
    <g stroke='#4dd0e1' stroke-width='1.5'>
      <line x1='24' y1='55' x2='24' y2='85'/>
      <line x1='9' y1='70' x2='39' y2='70'/>
      <line x1='13' y1='59' x2='35' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='35' y1='59' x2='13' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='76' y1='55' x2='76' y2='85'/>
      <line x1='61' y1='70' x2='91' y2='70'/>
      <line x1='65' y1='59' x2='87' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='87' y1='59' x2='65' y2='81'/>
    </g>
    <!-- frame -->
    <g stroke='#ff3d7f' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <path d='M 24 70 L 44 42 L 66 42 L 76 70'/>
      <path d='M 44 42 L 50 70 L 76 70'/>
      <path d='M 50 70 L 24 70'/>
    </g>
    <!-- seat post and seat -->
    <line x1='44' y1='42' x2='42' y2='32' stroke='#ff3d7f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <rect x='34' y='27' width='18' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd54f'/>
    <!-- handlebar -->
    <line x1='66' y1='42' x2='68' y2='30' stroke='#ff3d7f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='61' y1='30' x2='74' y2='30' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- pedals -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='5' fill='#ffd54f'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='74' x2='54' y2='66' stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sparkles -->
    <g fill='#fff176'>
      <path d='M 12 30 l 2 6 l 6 2 l -6 2 l -2 6 l -2 -6 l -6 -2 l 6 -2 z'/>
      <path d='M 88 22 l 1.6 5 l 5 1.6 l -5 1.6 l -1.6 5 l -1.6 -5 l -5 -1.6 l 5 -1.6 z'/>
      <path d='M 84 48 l 1.2 4 l 4 1.2 l -4 1.2 l -1.2 4 l -1.2 -4 l -4 -1.2 l 4 -1.2 z'/>
      <path d='M 16 50 l 1.2 4 l 4 1.2 l -4 1.2 l -1.2 4 l -1.2 -4 l -4 -1.2 l 4 -1.2 z'/>
      <path d='M 50 12 l 1.4 4.6 l 4.6 1.4 l -4.6 1.4 l -1.4 4.6 l -1.4 -4.6 l -4.6 -1.4 l 4.6 -1.4 z'/>
      <path d='M 30 92 l 1 3.4 l 3.4 1 l -3.4 1 l -1 3.4 l -1 -3.4 l -3.4 -1 l 3.4 -1 z'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
